Drop the itch.io CC0 "Retro Lines" tileset zip here (unzipped or as retro-lines.zip).
Source: https://v3x3d.itch.io/retro-lines (CC0 1.0 Universal)
The build pipeline will detect it once present; until then the Neon Node CC0
tileset (already vendored in assets/vendor/oga/) supplies the neon line-art.
